description: Red de estaciones de referencia GNSS de la Comunitat Valenciana (ERVA) is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Generalitat Valenciana. La red geodésica activa de la Comunitat Valenciana está compuesta por 10 estaciones GNSS, en permanente funcionamiento como servicio de posicionamiento, que distribuye correcciones en tiempo real y ficheros de observaciones RINEX horarios y diarios. Coverage: Generalitat Valenciana. The publisher named on the listing is Generalitat Valenciana. Its keywords include Cartografía de referencia, España, Comunitat Valenciana, Datos abiertos, ICV, REDGAE. The listing shows 6 download or service links in PLAIN, CSV. The listing shows 2026-08-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
